title: React Summit US 2026
summary: A hybrid React conference with an in-person and streamed day followed by a separate virtual day.
description: React Summit US 2026 takes place on November 17 at Liberty Science Center and virtually, followed by a fully virtual conference day on November 20. Workshops are offered separately during the month.

physical.name: Liberty Science Center
physical.instructions: Physical attendance is on November 17 only. November 20 is virtual only. The November 17–20 range does not assert conference activity on November 18 or 19.

virtual.instructions: Virtual access details are provided through the event and ticketing pages.

registration.instructions: Attendance mode and dates depend on the ticket. Regular: physical November 17 and remote November 20. Remote: online November 17 and 20. Workshops are offered separately.

tickets.name: React Summit US, Regular
tickets.description: Physical admission on November 17 and remote admission on November 20.

tickets.name: Remote React Summit, Early Bird
tickets.description: Remote admission on November 17 and November 20.
